functional.reason: Functional results were not produced with the skill evaluation tool: each eval needs a live ElastiCache fault (memory filled under noeviction, KEYS/HGETALL load, a hot key, connection churn, a too-tight client timeout) running while the agent investigates, and the tool provisions agent spaces but not the faulted resources. Instead the author ran the same comparison manually in two DevOps Agent spaces (with and without the skill) against injected faults on test clusters: 4 scenarios with 40 investigations, then two demo scenarios with 3 runs per side (12 investigations), scored per run with the rubric in evals/manual-functional-results.md, which also has one full response per side for each scenario. The approval-gated mitigation (Step 7) was demonstrated manually once (Demo C): after an investigation, the agent proposed one ModifyCacheParameterGroup change, applied it after operator approval through directed actions, and the result was verified in metrics and CloudTrail. Changes after the runs, not re-tested: the skill was restructured for best practices (diagnosis table in references/, checklist workflow, validation step); diagnosis rows were added for client-side causes found in earlier base-agent testing (retry bursts, network limits, climbing connections, IAM token expiry, in-transit encryption mismatch); and the content was checked against public AWS and Valkey documentation, which corrected details such as the serverless dimension name, CLUSTER SLOT-STATS statistics and replication-link metrics, and replaced undocumented numeric thresholds with explicit comparisons. Structure and best-practices results in this directory were produced with the tool.
